SELECT DISTINCT
    a.c,
        COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM sbtest1 AS a
    JOIN sbtest1 AS b
        ON b.id = a.id
    WHERE a.k > $1
      AND a.id = (
          SELECT MIN(x.id)
          FROM sbtest1 AS x
          WHERE x.c = a.c
      )
    GROUP BY a.c
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
